title: Rory and the Moonlit Cedar Ridge
verses:
The sun dipped down behind the ridge,
And painted skies of blue,
While Rory walked along the path,
Through grass of evening dew.

High overhead flew Nia now,
On wings of silver gray,
While Ricky rested on a rock,
To end the playful day.

Now Benny gave a heavy sigh,
Beside the cedar tree,
And Tilly gathered fragrant ferns,
As calm as calm could be.

Then Psittaco came fluttering down,
To seek a sheltered nest,
And chirped a song for all his friends,
Before they went to rest.

Then Rory made a cozy bed,
Beneath the starry light,
He closed his eyes and tucked his tail,
To welcome in the night.

The gentle breezes softly hummed,
Above the quiet hill,
And every dinosaur was safe,
And slumbering and still.
